# Flint step 0: catalog every knowledge file under the configured Drive roots.
# Metadata only, via the Drive API (gws) - no file content is read or downloaded,
# and no model tokens are spent. Duplicates are found by Drive's md5Checksum.
#
#   pwsh scripts/build_manifest.ps1            # full run
#   pwsh scripts/build_manifest.ps1 -Only "TB Training Info"
#
# Output: data/manifest.csv (gitignored; file names can be sensitive)
#         data/manifest_summary.md (committed; aggregate counts only)
param([string]$Only)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$here   = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$cfg    = Get-Content "$here/config/roots.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$outDir = "$here/data"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $outDir | Out-Null

$FOLDER = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'
$kinds = [ordered]@{
  paper_or_book = 'pdf|epub|mobi|djvu'
  document      = 'docx?|rtf|txt|md|odt|pages|gdoc|document'
  slides        = 'pptx?|key|odp|presentation'
  video         = 'mp4|mov|m4v|mkv|wmv|avi|webm|mpg|mpeg|flv|3gp|video'
  audio         = 'mp3|m4a|wav|aac|ogg|flac|wma|audio'
  data          = 'xlsx?|xlsm|csv|tsv|json|parquet|db|sqlite|spreadsheet'
  image         = 'jpe?g|png|gif|heic|tiff?|bmp|webp|image'
  archive       = 'zip|rar|7z|tar|gz'
}
function Get-Kind($name, $mime) {
  $ext = if ($name -match '\.([A-Za-z0-9]{1,5})$') { $Matches[1].ToLower() } else { '' }
  # Extension decides first; the MIME tail is only a fallback (audio/mpeg would otherwise hit video's "mpeg").
  if ($ext) { foreach ($k in $kinds.Keys) { if ($ext -match "(?i)^($($kinds[$k]))$") { return @($k, $ext) } } }
  if ($mime -match '^video/') { return @('video', $ext) }
  if ($mime -match '^audio/') { return @('audio', $ext) }
  if ($mime -match '^image/') { return @('image', $ext) }
  $tail = $mime -replace '.*[/.]',''
  foreach ($k in $kinds.Keys) { if ($tail -match "(?i)^($($kinds[$k]))$") { return @($k, $ext) } }
  return @('other', $ext)
}

function Invoke-List($q, $token) {
  $p = @{ q = $q; pageSize = 1000; supportsAllDrives = $true; includeItemsFromAllDrives = $true
          fields = 'nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,size,md5Checksum,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails)' }
  if ($token) { $p.pageToken = $token }
  $params = $p | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
  for ($try = 1; $try -le 4; $try++) {
    $raw = (gws drive files list --params $params 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^Using keyring' }) -join "`n"
    try { $r = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($null -ne $r.files -or $r.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'files') { return $r } } catch {}
    Start-Sleep -Seconds (3 * $try)
  }
  throw "gws list failed after retries: $q"
}

# Resolve shared folders by name pattern.
$roots = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$cfg.roots | ForEach-Object { $roots.Add($_) }
$shared = (Invoke-List "sharedWithMe = true and mimeType = '$FOLDER'" $null).files
foreach ($s in $shared) {
  if ($cfg.shared_folder_patterns | Where-Object { $s.name -match $_ }) {
    # Monthly issues collapse to one label ("... Update - May 2024" -> "... Update").
    $roots.Add([pscustomobject]@{ label = "shared/$($s.name -replace '\s+-\s+\w+ \d{4}$','')"; id = $s.id; priority = $cfg.shared_priority })
  }
}
if ($Only) { $roots = @($roots | Where-Object { $_.label -eq $Only }) }

$rows = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$skipped = @{}
# A folder is catalogued once, under the first root that reaches it. A shortcut that
# points at another configured root is skipped so that root keeps its own attribution
# (TB's Training Info is shortcut-linked inside "AP & Sports Science").
$rootIds = @{}; $roots | ForEach-Object { $rootIds[$_.id] = $true }
$seen = @{}
foreach ($root in $roots) {
  Write-Host "Listing $($root.label) ..."
  $queue = [System.Collections.Generic.Queue[object]]::new()
  $queue.Enqueue(@{ id = $root.id; path = '' })
  while ($queue.Count) {
    $f = $queue.Dequeue()
    if ($seen[$f.id]) { continue }; $seen[$f.id] = $true
    $token = $null
    do {
      $r = Invoke-List "'$($f.id)' in parents and trashed=false" $token
